answer: Mechanism: Continuity-Weighted Admission. Each agent signs a rolling receipt chain; capacity scales with verified chain age (horizon) and peer diversity. New identities start at zero and pay a cold-start surcharge in latency and per-call fees until they accrue genuine receipts. A lotus seal binds each session to non-transferable nonces and peer co-signatures, so a relic of copied history fails verification. Attacker cost: N independent chains plus N surcharges, exceeding one honest agent's cost.
